examples.text: The water shone pacifically; the sky, without a speck, was a benign immensity of unstained light; the very mist on the Essex marshes was like a gauzy and radiant fabric, hung from the wooded rises inland, and draping the low shores in diaphanous folds.

examples.text: So proud she shyned in her Princely state.

examples.text: Few are qualified to shine in company; but it in most men's power to be agreeable.

examples.text: I shone my light into the darkness to see what was making the noise.

examples.text: He shined my shoes until they were polished smooth and gleaming.
